profile.name: Hatsawat Intrasod
profile.role: Application Developer | M.Sc. Computer Science Student at KMITL
profile.bio: Application Developer at T.C.C. Technology and Master of Computer Science student at KMITL. Focused on Go (Golang) backend services, API security, database reliability, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.

experiences.title: Application Developer
description: Developed and maintained Go (Golang) backend services and RESTful APIs for order management, order cap design, delivery tracking, merchant onboarding, nearby landmark search, stage-aware FCM notifications, audit logging, and Omise payment webhook investigation.
Implemented backend user key exchange APIs in Go to support encrypted and decrypted messaging between buyers and sellers, along with chat log handling.

Hardened and refactored Go (Golang) services by fixing SQL Injection, IDOR, database transaction leaks, and negative/length input validation, migrating logging to zerolog, centralizing JSON error handling, removing unused routes, and writing data-patch scripts.

Reverse-engineered a legacy POS system into PRD specifications and OpenAPI (Scalar) contracts, and built an AI-powered automated review pipeline verifying specs against live APIs and Android Emulator (ADB).
Operated a human-in-the-loop multi-agent AI workflow (SDD → TDD) covering automated issue splitting, spec/test-plan generation, role-scoped agent implementation, and automated test verification.

experiences.title: Developer (Freelance) - Mordin Project
description: Responsible for developing a comprehensive internal web application using React, enabling administrators to manage soil sample data and complex laboratory results.
Developed a public-facing website for farmers using PHP Flight to deliver personalized agricultural data and recommendations.
Implemented a RESTful API with NestJS to handle all system data, from user accounts to scientific analysis results.

experiences.title: Application Developer Intern
description: Developed C# functions to convert SQL queries between MSSQL and DB2, using the Composite Pattern to handle nested-IF conditions.
Built and maintained backend services using C#, handling API endpoints and business logic.
Designed and implemented dynamic web components using Angular, integrating frontend pages with backend APIs.
Collaborated on developing user interfaces with dynamic components and several web pages to enhance user experience.
